ev.q: Masking and isolation occurred in 88% (71 of 81) drills when travel history was obtained
Median time from patient entry to masking was 1.5 minutes (range = 0–47 minutes)
Overall, 84 (88%) patients were given a mask
there were no significant differences in the percentage of simulated MERS and measles patients who received a mask
Exercises were designed in accordance with the U.S. Department of Homeland Security Exercise and Evaluation Program
Based on these findings, performance goals of 1 minute from entry to masking and 10 minutes from entry to isolation will be adopted

methods_quotes.q: Descriptive analyses and chi-square tests for association were performed using statistical software with p-values <0.05 considered to be statistically significant.
Variable specific analyses of times excluded drills with missing time stamp data.
